title: The QR factorization of a banded-plus-semiseparable matrix is computable in linear complexity with Householder reflections
summary: We show that the QR factorization of a banded-plus-semiseparable (BPS) matrix is computable in optimal linear complexity with respect to the discretization size by showing that the intermediate stages of a QR factorization as computed using Householder reflection maintain a specific structure which has optimal storage.
